_why: Tile properties copied from vanilla appliances_television_01_0 (TvWideScreen) minus the tabletop keys: this is a floor set. IsoType=IsoTelevision + signal=tv are what make the engine build an IsoTelevision; Facing (written per cell by the builder) drives IsoTelevision.isFacing. Overlay and placeholder cells carry tile_props {} in the manifest and bypass all of this.
